skill_outcomes.skill_name: History and Development of Labour Psychology
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the history and development of labour psychology as the basis for scientific organization of work and human resource management.
Understand and apply research methods in labour psychology.
Analyze the formation of personality in workers and the psychological basis for developing their abilities.
Understand and explain various psychological states in work and their causes.
Apply principles of controlling worker behavior.
Analyze group dynamics and team management techniques.
Understand the psychological aspects of leadership and management.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve problems in the workplace.
Improve communication skills for effective interaction with colleagues and superiors.
Develop self-directed learning skills to continuously improve professional competence.
Work collaboratively to identify and solve complex problems in teams.
